This plot is my yam and cassava ground, and my father farmed tubers the same way before me. I do not buy the chemical fertilizer for roots — it costs too much and the yams do well enough with the bush fallow and the droppings from my goats that I spread before making the heaps. I keep my own seed yams from last harvest like everyone here, and for yam mounds there is plenty of hard work, so I will call two or three young men to help me with the mounding and weeding when my sons cannot finish it alone.
